parameters.query:
SELECT e.wamid, e.telefone_digits, e.phone_number_id, e.ctwa_clid, e.primeiro_contato_em
FROM ctwa_eventos e
LEFT JOIN capi_envios c ON c.event_id = 'vc-' || e.wamid
WHERE e.ctwa_clid IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NULL
  AND e.primeiro_contato_em > now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY e.primeiro_contato_em LIMIT 200;
